verdict.rationale: Persona explicitly supports recurring re-screening via 'Reports can be configured to run in regular intervals against an account' (persona-docs-19), including a dedicated Watchlist report type (persona-docs-15), and webhooks notify integrators of events on any resource including subsets of event types (persona-docs-2, persona-docs-17) — together covering continuous re-screening plus actionable change events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of recurring watchlist monitoring in production and explicit documentation of watchlist-update-triggered event payloads.
